text:
tara: Heads up team — we're rolling out a Soft-Rate Smoothing and Rollover Pilot for hosted customers starting 2026-07-01 UTC. This affects metering, invoice exports, and billing API flags.

mike: Summary: introduce a 72-hour soft smoothing window before promoting accounts into higher rate tiers, plus an optional small rollover pool for unused free credits (pilot cap $300/account/month).

sasha: Finance: credits show as invoice line `soft_smoothing_credit` or `rollover_credit`. Retro adjustments allowed for 45 days. PDF will show a single line item; CSV will include detail columns.

billing-bot: New invoice CSV columns: account_id,period_start,period_end,total_tokens,billed_tokens,applied_smoothing_credit,applied_rollover_amount. API: add ?include_smoothing=true.

sasha: Dedicated/reserved customers are not auto-enrolled. If they want smoothing we can enable per-contract.

tara: Support please prepare short answers: "Does this change pricing?" -> "No, unit prices unchanged; this smooths tier moves and can apply small credits for transient spikes."

mike: Engineering notes: we'll accept header X-Redwood-Metering-Smoothing: enabled and expose a /v2/billing-metadata endpoint. Old headers supported for 60 days post-launch.

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-SRS-2026 and scheduled rollout tasks. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-SRS-2026

sasha: Action items:
- @sasha: publish pilot FAQ and sample invoice.
- @mike: API + CSV schema PR.
- @tara: support playbook and canned replies.
- @ops-bot: monitoring dashboard and weekly pilot report.

tara: We'll notify top customers and run an internal dry run with support next Wednesday. Ping here for reviews. :thumbsup:
